evidence.snippet: The Otter.ai public API is currently in beta and requires an Enterprise plan. Contact your Otter account manager for API access.

decisions.reason: Access requires contacting an Otter account manager rather than a self-serve purchase, matching contact_sales.

evidence.snippet: Generate your access token in Otter.ai: Enterprise Settings → API → Generate Token

decisions.reason: The token is manually generated as a static bearer credential but is explicitly described as an OAuth access token, so both apply.
